Unlimited access Harmonised access to data from across the network of CORE providers. Machine-readable access Direct machine access to full texts of research papers. Detailed documentation Accessible and easy to understand description of using CORE API. How it works CORE collects, harmonises and enriches large quantities of both metadata and full text research articles from thousands of data providers . On top of this continuously growing corpus, we provide a truly unique API providing real-time machine access to both the metadata and full texts of research papers, enabling developers to build and run innovative applications on top of CORE's content. Access documentation see data statistics Viktor Botev CTO, Iris AI AS “We are integrating the CORE API into our product, IRIS, because so far it is the open access portal that covers almost all open access content, provides easy to integrate API and has a powerful search querying engine. We want to make open access articles more easily accessible and more useful to researchers and the open public and we see the CORE API as a way to speed that up.” SEE More testimonials Where to start? Please register to receive an API key 
and start testing the live examples . A good starting point to start coding with our API is to
follow the examples gallery available in the documentation .
In collaboration with rOpenSci you can find
an R client for the CORE API in the GitHub repository.
All our SDKs are available from our GitHub organisation . Can I use the CORE API for commercial purposes? Yes, you can use the CORE API for commercial purposes,
 (Terms & Conditions) apply.
We provide 30 Day Free Trial for Institution and Enterprise.
We will ask you for your circumstances during the registration process
and we might contact you afterwards to clarify any points and assess your eligibility
for a free licence. If your circumstances change, you need to let us know about it. Rate limits CORE API is free and does not require registration, subject to our rate limits . However, organisations that register get a faster rate that is typically not free. For Supporting and Sustaining Members , the faster rate comes as a free member benefit. If you use CORE in your work, we kindly request you to cite one of our publications. cite publication Show all What’s included The API provides you with: Real-time machine access to the world's largest corpus of open access research papers, containing both metadata and full texts. Harmonised access to data accross CORE’s provider network Detailed documentation on how to use the CORE API with live examples and wrappers to common programming languages. One batch request or five single requests per 10 seconds. Need a faster rate? Contact us . Scalable API rates: Free API access without registration (subject to our T&Cs) Better performance for registered users Need an even faster rate? Contact us for a VIP rate quote. If you use CORE in your work, we kindly request you to cite one of our publications. Find out how other institutions benefited from CORE API How the Oxford University Research Archive (ORA) uses the CORE API CORE indexes and aggregates information of research papers collected from institutional and subject repositories, and open access and hybrid journals, and makes the content available via an API. The CORE API offers a wealth of metadata and full text content from its many data providers. For ORA (Oxford University Research Archive), the use of the CORE API offers an opportunity to enhance workflows and streamline the process of reviewing and curating articles for inclusion in the repository... Jason Partridge Open Access Service Manager at the Bodleian Libraries, University of Oxford. read more more than 57M full texts more than 452M searchable research papers more than 16K data providers more than 150 countries see data statistics Register for an API key Enter your email address to register for a new API key, or restore a previous API key. We will send the key and instructions to this address Email Register now Check our Terms & Conditions to see if you are eligible for a free license.
